claims.alegacao: As correcoes impressas pelo nucleo apontam ork gate request, o bloqueio de push aponta ork ship --autorizar-push, e board, monitor, retry, fix, ship, auditoria, gates, hosts e o contrato HITL seguem verdes
verificar: npm --prefix core run build:test && node --test core/dist-test/test/board.test.js core/dist-test/test/orquestracao.test.js core/dist-test/test/hitl-migracao-v1.test.js core/dist-test/test/hosts.test.js core/dist-test/test/ship.test.js core/dist-test/test/retry.test.js core/dist-test/test/fix.test.js core/dist-test/test/auditoria.test.js core/dist-test/test/gate.test.js core/dist-test/test/hitl-gates.test.js core/dist-test/test/evalrunner.test.js

claims.alegacao: Skills e evals roteiam para gate request, ship --autorizar-push e ork master, e o corpus das skills e os canarios seguem verdes
ork_master_batch roda ork master --todas --json no src e no dist do OpenClaw, os testes do plugin passam, e o Hermes nao declara nem entrega os scripts ork-objective
verificar: grep -qF "argv: () => ['master', '--todas', '--json']" adapters/openclaw/src/index.ts && grep -qF "argv: () => ['master', '--todas', '--json']" adapters/openclaw/dist/index.js && node --test adapters/openclaw/test/*.test.mjs && test ! -e adapters/hermes/bin/ork-objective-status.sh && test ! -e adapters/hermes/bin/ork-objective-message.sh && ! grep -q objective adapters/hermes/hermes.plugin.json

claims.alegacao: Guias, quickstart, referencia, definicao de pronto e CHANGELOG com paridade, lint e links limpos
verificar: node core/dist/index.js docs verificar && core/node_modules/.bin/markdownlint-cli2 && node core/scripts/checar-links.cjs

claims.alegacao: Fora das notas de aposentadoria, nenhum arquivo do produto ensina ork gate approve, ork master --batch ou ork objective
verificar: test -z "$(git grep -n -E "ork gate approve|master --batch|ork objective (new|status|message|list|approve)|'master', '--batch'" -- . ':!.ork-ci' ':!core/test' ':!CHANGELOG.md' | grep -v -i -E 'aposentad|saiu|usava-se')"
